comment: Shared slice-decomposition schedule vectors for the streamed det-lane fold walks (ingest and make_update share the schedule; they differ only in per-window math). Each case pins: the window enumeration of a parameter layout at window_size bytes (per-parameter chunking — a parameter never spans a window, tails short, ordinal = family chunk ordinal), and the completion-driven walk contract under an explicit arrival permutation: folds execute ascending and contiguous regardless of arrival order, at most in_flight reads are outstanding, issues are ascending, and the seal fires exactly once — in the slice that folds the last window (slice 0 is the opening issue slice; completion i is slice i+1). Window tuples are [ordinal, param, param_off, len]; slice entries are [fold ordinals, issue ordinals, seal].

cases.name: degenerate single-window walk (the 64-dim tier shape): issue, fold, seal in one completion slice
parameter tails: 16/4/8 f32 at window 24 give 3+1+2 windows with two short tails
out-of-order completions: folds stay ascending and contiguous, blocked windows buffer
reads run ahead bounded: in_flight 1 serializes the walk
multi-chunk parameter with a whole-window tail parameter
